_meta.what: Per-sector feed for Petroleum Refining & Export: the sector's registered channels with today's published scores, 95% sampling bands, and weights under the registered exposure rule. IGRM measures press salience -- the share of global news coverage matching registered channel dictionaries, ranked against each channel's own trailing two years. It is not a measure of risk and makes no forecasts. This feed re-cuts published numbers by one registered sector's frame and adds no new claim.
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/

label: Petroleum Refining & Export
rationale: India's largest export by value: crude in from the Gulf, refined products out by sea; doubly exposed to Hormuz and the western corridors.
